prompt.en: Which sentence is correct: 'The king told Rama that he was clever.' or 'The king said Rama that he was clever.'?
prompt.hi: 'Said' aur 'told' mein farak — kis ke saath person ka naam seedha aata hai?

challenges.hint: One of these verbs needs a person right after it.

options.text: The king told Rama that he was clever.
The king said Rama that he was clever.

challenges.keyText: The king told Rama that he was clever.

prompt.en: Read this scene: 'GOPAL (holding a bucket): Seth-ji, I paid you fifty coins for this well. Why do you stop me from drawing water? / SETH (folding his arms): I sold you the well, Gopal, not the water inside it.' How much did Gopal pay for the well?
prompt.hi: Scene suno. Gopal ne kuan kitne mein khareeda tha?

challenges.hint: It is a number of coins.

prompt.en: Which sentence shows that the injury came BEFORE the battle? (a) 'His arm was injured when the battle began.' (b) 'His arm had been injured before the battle began.'
prompt.hi: Dono mein se kaunsa saaf batata hai ki chot pehle lagi thi, ladai baad mein?

challenges.hint: 'Had + verb' marks the earlier of two past events.

options.text: (a) 'His arm was injured when the battle began.'
(b) 'His arm had been injured before the battle began.'

challenges.keyText: (b) 'His arm had been injured before the battle began.'
